description: This file contains utility functions for string manipulation, escaping, formatting, and regex handling used within the Playwright project.

methods.name: escapeWithQuotes
methods.description: Escapes a string with quotes, replacing special characters based on the specified quote character.

methods.name: escapeTemplateString
methods.description: Escapes backslashes, backticks, and '${' in template strings.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if an object is a string.

methods.name: toTitleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to title case (first letter uppercase).

methods.name: toSnakeCase
methods.description: Converts a string from camelCase or PascalCase to snake_case.

methods.name: formatObject
methods.description: Formats an object into a string with indentation and mode options.

methods.name: formatObjectOrVoid
methods.description: Formats an object or returns an empty string if the object is empty.

methods.name: quoteCSSAttributeValue
methods.description: Quotes a CSS attribute value, escaping internal quotes and backslashes.

methods.name: cacheNormalizedWhitespaces
methods.description: Initializes the cache for normalized whitespace.

methods.name: normalizeWhiteSpace
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace in a string, using cache if available.

methods.name: normalizeEscapedRegexQuotes
methods.description: Reverses the escaping of quotes in regex strings.

methods.name: escapeRegexForSelector
methods.description: Escapes regex for use in CSS selectors, considering unicode flags.

methods.name: escapeForTextSelector
methods.description: Escapes a string or regex for use in text selectors, with optional exact matching.

methods.name: escapeForAttributeSelector
methods.description: Escapes a string or regex for use in attribute selectors, with optional exact matching.

methods.name: trimString
methods.description: Trims a string to a specified length, adding a suffix if truncated.

methods.name: trimStringWithEllipsis
methods.description: Trims a string with an ellipsis if it exceeds the specified length.

methods.name: escapeRegExp
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for use in regex.

methods.name: escapeHTMLAttribute
methods.description: Escapes special characters for HTML attribute values.

methods.name: escapeHTML
methods.description: Escapes special characters for HTML content.

methods.name: longestCommonSubstring
methods.description: Finds the longest common substring between two strings.

methods.name: parseRegex
methods.description: Parses a string into a RegExp object, expecting delimiters and flags.

methods.name: stripAnsiEscapes
methods.description: Removes ANSI escape sequences from a string.
